description: Check another URL next to the main one, on the same schedule and two-of-three-regions rule: an API, a health endpoint, the checkout. Up to 3 extra per app on Starter, 10 on Builder and Pro. Returns the check id and whether it passes now. Needs write access.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.

body.description: POST only: the request body, sent as-is (JSON must parse)

expect_status.description: Exact status code that counts as up, e.g. 200. Omit: any 2xx or 3xx.

expect_text.description: Text the response must contain, from one line of the page

headers.description: Extra request headers, e.g. { "Authorization": "Bearer …" }. Saved encrypted and never shown again. On update, replaces all saved headers; leave out to keep them.

json_path.description: JSON field that must exist, like status or checks[0].ok

url.description: Full public URL, or a path on the app like /api/health

name: add_check
title: Add an extra check
